chapter.heading: Ezekiel 6
Judgment Against Idolatry
chapter.v: 6 The word of the Lord came to me:
and I will destroy your high places.
incense altars shall be broken, and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
incense altars cut down, and your works wiped out.
And the slain shall fall in your midst, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
some who escape the sword, and when you are scattered through the countries,
And they will be loathsome in their own sight for the evils that they have committed, for all their abominations.
I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”
for they shall fall by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.
Thus I will spend my fury upon them.
they offered pleasing aroma to all their idols.
they will know that I am the Lord .”
